result.instructions: Tools for Cloudflare, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which DNS records point at our old server, and what are their TTLs?"; "List all zones in our account and show which ones are not active yet."; "Purge the cache for our product page and its images.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cloudflare data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cloudflare_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cloudflare_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cloudflare_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cloudflare_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cloudflare_verify_token
tools.title: Verify the API token
tools.description: Check that the configured API token is active and show its id and status. Cheap first call to confirm the connection. Cloudflare API: GET /user/tokens/verify.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the Cloudflare accounts this token can access, with their ids and names. Use the id as account_id in the account tools. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_account_members
tools.title: List account members
tools.description: List the members of an account with their status and roles. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/members.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_audit_logs
tools.title: List audit logs
tools.description: List account audit log entries (who changed what and when), filterable by time range, action type and actor email. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/audit_logs.

action_type.description: Filter by action type (e.g. create, delete, update).

tools.name: cloudflare_list_zones
tools.title: List zones
tools.description: List DNS zones (domains) in the token's accounts, with status, plan and name servers. Use the id as zone_id in the zone tools. Cloudflare API: GET /zones.

name.description: Filter by domain name, e.g. example.com.

account_id.description: Only zones in this account id.

tools.name: cloudflare_get_zone
tools.title: Get a zone
tools.description: Get one zone with its status, plan, name servers and activation state. Cloudflare API: GET /zones/{zone_id}.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_dns_records
tools.title: List DNS records
tools.description: List DNS records of a zone, filterable by type and name. Each record has its id, type, name, content, TTL and proxy state. Cloudflare API: GET /zones/{zone_id}/dns_records.

content.description: Exact record content (for example an IP address).

tools.name: cloudflare_get_dns_record
tools.title: Get a DNS record
tools.description: Get one DNS record by id, with its type, name, content, TTL, proxy state and comment. Cloudflare API: GET /zones/{zone_id}/dns_records/{dns_record_id}.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_workers
tools.title: List Workers
tools.description: List the Worker scripts deployed in an account, with their names and last-modified times. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_kv_namespaces
tools.title: List KV namespaces
tools.description: List Workers KV namespaces in an account, with their ids and titles. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_kv_keys
tools.title: List KV keys
tools.description: List key names in a Workers KV namespace (names only, not values). Use cursor from the result for the next page. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/keys.

prefix.description: Only keys that start with this prefix.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_d1_databases
tools.title: List D1 databases
tools.description: List D1 SQL databases in an account, with their ids, names and regions. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/d1/database.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_r2_buckets
tools.title: List R2 buckets
tools.description: List R2 object storage buckets in an account, with names, locations and creation times. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets.

name_contains.description: Only buckets whose name contains this text.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_pages_projects
tools.title: List Pages projects
tools.description: List Cloudflare Pages projects in an account, with their latest deployment and domains. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_tunnels
tools.title: List Tunnels
tools.description: List Cloudflare Tunnels (cloudflared) in an account, with their status and connection state. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_access_apps
tools.title: List Access applications
tools.description: List Cloudflare Access applications (Zero Trust protected apps) in an account, with their domains and session settings. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/access/apps.

tools.name: cloudflare_list_queues
tools.title: List Queues
tools.description: List Cloudflare Queues in an account, with their ids, names and creation times. Cloudflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/queues.

tools.name: cloudflare_create_dns_record
tools.title: Create a DNS record
tools.description: Create a DNS record in a zone. This changes live DNS: the new record takes effect for visitors after the TTL. Cloudflare API: POST /zones/{zone_id}/dns_records.

name.description: Record name, e.g. www or www.example.com.

content.description: Record value, e.g. an IP address or a hostname.

proxied.description: Route traffic through Cloudflare (A, AAAA, CNAME only).

comment.description: Short note stored with the record.

tools.name: cloudflare_update_dns_record
tools.title: Update a DNS record
tools.description: Change fields of an existing DNS record (for example its content, TTL or proxy state). This changes live DNS. Only the fields you pass change. Cloudflare API: PATCH /zones/{zone_id}/dns_records/{dns_record_id}.

ttl.description: New TTL in seconds; 1 means automatic.

proxied.description: New proxy state (A, AAAA, CNAME only).

comment.description: New note stored with the record.

tools.name: cloudflare_purge_cache
tools.title: Purge the cache
tools.description: Remove cached files from Cloudflare's edge for a zone: all files, or only the listed URLs. Visitors then fetch fresh content from the origin. Cloudflare API: POST /zones/{zone_id}/purge_cache.

purge_everything.description: true = purge the whole zone cache. Use with care.

files.description: Up to 30 full URLs to purge.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Cloudflare
prompts.description: What you can do with Cloudflare here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_dns_records_and_their_ttls
prompts.title: Find DNS records and their TTLs
prompts.description: List the zones of the token with their status and plan. List the DNS records of one zone, filtered by type or name, with their TTL and proxy state.

prompts.name: list_workers_kv_and_r2_resources
prompts.title: List Workers, KV and R2 resources
prompts.description: List the Worker scripts of an account with their last change time. List its KV namespaces and R2 buckets.

prompts.name: review_audit_log_entries_and_account_members
prompts.title: Review audit log entries and account members
prompts.description: List the audit log entries with a time range and actor filters. List the account members with their roles.

prompts.name: add_a_dns_record_to_a_zone
prompts.title: Add a DNS record to a zone
prompts.description: Create a DNS record in a zone. The change is live, and visitors see it after the TTL.

prompts.name: purge_cached_files_after_a_release
prompts.title: Purge cached files after a release
prompts.description: Purge the cache of a zone, or only the listed URLs. Visitors then fetch fresh content from the origin.
